paper_id: Cloud-Native Computing_ A Survey from the Perspective of Services
title: Cloud-Native Computing: A Survey from the Perspective of Services
motivation: 尽管云原生在工业界势头强劲,但仍缺乏清晰的研究路线图。
problem_framing: 从服务视角将云原生应用生命周期解耦为四个状态进行系统综述。
key_insight: 云原生应用可视为由松耦合微服务组成的分布式弹性系统,需按生命周期各状态系统梳理关键问题。
method_signature: survey: 按building/orchestration/operate/maintenance四状态组织文献并总结性能指标。
evaluation_criteria: 应用层延迟/响应时间、平台层可扩展性/稳定性、基础设施层资源利用率。
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 现有survey主要提供高层观点,忽略对state-of-the-art research works的review,in the lack of systematic knowledge。
evidence_for_taste: clear research roadmap on this topic is still missing
in the lack of systematic knowledge
To the best of our knowledge, this is the first survey focusing on key issues during the life-cycle
thinking_moves: 识别现有survey缺乏系统性知识梳理的gap
提出pipeline式设计组织研究领域
将生命周期解耦为building→orchestration→operate→maintenance四个状态
自上而下分解云原生架构为应用层/平台层/基础设施层三层性能指标
